_comment: Brand settings for the cover generator. Change the hex colors to your brand. Every template color token ({{bg}}, {{accent}} and so on) comes from the palette picked for a post. Add a palette by copying one and giving it a new name; --color then accepts that name. See RULES.md.
_comment_topic_rules: First match wins. Each value is a regular expression tested against the title plus --topic, in lowercase. A title that matches nothing uses default_color.
